# Lab 27.9: Create an Assured Workloads Folder

## What We Are Going to Do
Create an Assured Workloads folder for a compliance regime, see the controls it applies, and trigger a violation.

## Steps

1. **Check requirements.** You need **Assured Workloads Administrator** at organization level and a billing account. Some control packages have extra charges or need approval, so read the package description before creating.

2. **Create the workload in the console.** Go to **Compliance → Assured Workloads → Create workload**.
   - Choose a control package available to your organization, for example a regional data boundary package for the US or the EU
   - Name: `aw-lab`
   - Choose the billing account
   - Review the controls and create

   The same with gcloud:

<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud assured workloads create \
  --organization=ORG_ID \
  --location=us \
  --display-name=aw-lab \
  --compliance-regime=COMPLIANCE_REGIME \
  --billing-account=billingAccounts/BILLING_ACCOUNT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **See what was created.** A new folder appears in the resource hierarchy. Open **Organization policies** for that folder. You see policies such as **Resource Location Restriction** and **Restrict Resource Service Usage** already set.

4. **Create a project inside it** and try to create a bucket in a region outside the boundary. It fails.

5. **Trigger a violation.** In the folder's organization policies, change **Resource Location Restriction** to allow all locations. Go back to **Assured Workloads → aw-lab → Violations**. A violation appears, with steps to fix it.

6. **Fix it.** Restore the policy and acknowledge the violation.

7. **Clean up.** Delete projects inside the folder, then delete the workload.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Folder | Created with compliance controls |
| Controls | Org policies applied automatically |
| Changing them | Raises a violation |
| Package | Chosen at creation, matches the regulation |
